messages:
Maya: customer report: stream was GC'd mid-response, toolcall returned, client reconnected and we billed twice. can we trace ledger?
Owen: any log snippet?
Maya: redacted: 
```
router: evict session=s-9 seq=110 reason=kv_gc
stream: truncate session=s-9 truncated_tokens=40
toolcall: id=tc-21 result_tokens=30
client: reconnect session=s-9b resume=108
toolcall: id=tc-21 result_tokens=30 (replay)
billing: confirmed tokens=60
```
Priya: looks like we confirm on toolcall_done. unsafe for streaming.
Sam: short-term: dedupe by toolcall id within 1m window. long-term: provisional writes + commit ack from client.
Owen: telemetry: add metric duplicate_toolcalls and provisional_reconcile_latency.
Maya: console request view: show "pending tokens" and reconcile timestamp. ops wants an alert if duplicates >0.5% for 5m.
ops-bot: noted. will create canary job once PR lands.
Priya: owners: Sam (ledger), Maya (router events), Owen (telemetry/alerts), I'll do UI. Sam: please spec DB change.
Sam: will open PR. repro steps in RFC.
